title: Fix bugs in a Go key-value store serializer
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in a simple key-value store: Set overwrites the wrong key, Keys returns keys in wrong order (should be sorted), and Delete does not remove the entry.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in kv.go.

Bug 1 — Set: uses hardcoded key "fixed" instead of the parameter.
  Fix: change `s.data["fixed"] = value` to `s.data[key] = value`

Bug 2 — Keys: sorts in reverse order instead of ascending.
  Fix: change `sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(keys)))` to `sort.Strings(keys)`

Bug 3 — Delete: deletes hardcoded key "fixed" instead of the parameter.
  Fix: change `delete(s.data, "fixed")` to `delete(s.data, key)`

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Set stores value under the correct key parameter
Keys returns keys in ascending sorted order
Delete removes the correct key parameter
GetMissing returns false for absent keys
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
